# Publishes a per-pull-request DocGen preview, generated in diff mode against
# the base branch, next to the published site, and links it from the pull
# request. Closing the pull request removes the preview again.
#
# Requires docs.yml (or an equivalent) to own the root of the documentation
# branch: this workflow only ever writes below `pr/<number>/`.
#
# Pull requests from forks run with a read-only token, so their preview is
# generated but not published. Publishing those needs the hardened
# `workflow_run` pattern: build on `pull_request` and upload an artifact, then
# publish it from a separate workflow that runs on the default branch. Never
# switch this workflow to `pull_request_target`; that would run untrusted code
# with a write token.
name: Docs Preview

on:
  pull_request:
    types:
      - opened
      - synchronize
      - reopened
      - closed

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

env:
  COMPOSER_NO_INTERACTION: '1'
  DOCS_BRANCH: gh-pages
  SITE_DIR: build/docs
  PREVIEW_MARKER: '<!-- doc-gen-preview -->'
  # Set to the site address when Pages serves a custom domain, such as
  # https://docs.example.com. Empty means https://<owner>.github.io/<repo>.
  PAGES_BASE_URL: ''

jobs:
  preview:
    name: Generate and publish the pull request preview
    if: github.event.action != 'closed'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    permissions:
      contents: write
      pull-requests: write
    steps:
      # Diff mode checks the base revision out into a temporary worktree, so
      # the history of both revisions has to be present.
      - name: Check out the pull request
        uses: actions/checkout@9c091bb21b7c1c1d1991bb908d89e4e9dddfe3e0 # v7.0.0
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Set up PHP
        uses: shivammathur/setup-php@f3e473d116dcccaddc5834248c87452386958240 # 2.37.2
        with:
          php-version: '8.4'
          extensions: mbstring, pcntl
          coverage: none

      - name: Install dependencies
        uses: ramsey/composer-install@65e4f84970763564f46a70b8a54b90d033b3bdda # 4.0.0
        with:
          dependency-versions: locked
          composer-options: --prefer-dist

      - name: Restore the DocGen cache
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: build/doc-gen-cache
          key: doc-gen-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('composer.lock') }}-${{ github.sha }}
          restore-keys: |
            doc-gen-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('composer.lock') }}-
            doc-gen-${{ runner.os }}-

      - name: Generate the documentation in diff mode
        env:
          BASE_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}
        run: vendor/bin/doc-gen --config=doc.yaml --diff="${BASE_SHA}"

      - name: Explain why a fork pull request is not published
        if: github.event.pull_request.head.repo.fork
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          {
            printf '## Documentation preview\n\n'
            printf 'The site was generated but not published: a pull request from a fork'
            printf ' runs with a read-only token, so it cannot write to the `%s` branch.\n' "${DOCS_BRANCH}"
          } >> "${GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY}"

      - name: Publish the preview to the documentation branch
        if: ${{ !github.event.pull_request.head.repo.fork }}
        env:
          PR_NUMBER: ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
          COMMIT_MESSAGE: 'docs: preview pull request #${{ github.event.pull_request.number }} at ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}'
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          test -f "${SITE_DIR}/index.html" || {
            echo "No generated site at ${SITE_DIR}; refusing to publish." >&2
            exit 1
          }

          site="$(cd "${SITE_DIR}" && pwd)"
          worktree="$(mktemp -d)/docs-branch"
          published=''

          # The default branch publishes to the same branch, so a run that
          # loses the race refetches the branch and replays its own change.
          for attempt in 1 2 3; do
            rm -rf "${worktree}"
            git worktree prune

            if git fetch --no-tags --depth=1 origin "+refs/heads/${DOCS_BRANCH}:refs/remotes/origin/${DOCS_BRANCH}"; then
              git worktree add --quiet -B "${DOCS_BRANCH}" "${worktree}" "origin/${DOCS_BRANCH}"
            else
              echo "Creating the ${DOCS_BRANCH} branch."
              git worktree add --quiet --detach "${worktree}"
              git -C "${worktree}" switch --quiet --orphan "${DOCS_BRANCH}"
            fi

            rm -rf "${worktree}/pr/${PR_NUMBER}"
            mkdir -p "${worktree}/pr/${PR_NUMBER}"
            cp -a "${site}/." "${worktree}/pr/${PR_NUMBER}/"
            # Jekyll is disabled for the whole site from its root, which the
            # preview may reach before the site itself has been published.
            touch "${worktree}/.nojekyll"

            git -C "${worktree}" add --all
            if git -C "${worktree}" diff --cached --quiet; then
              echo "The ${DOCS_BRANCH} branch already serves this preview."
              published='unchanged'
              break
            fi

            git -C "${worktree}" \
              -c user.name='github-actions[bot]' \
              -c user.email='41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com' \
              commit --quiet --message "${COMMIT_MESSAGE}"

            if git -C "${worktree}" push --quiet origin "HEAD:refs/heads/${DOCS_BRANCH}"; then
              published='pushed'
              break
            fi

            echo "The ${DOCS_BRANCH} branch moved while publishing; retrying (attempt ${attempt} of 3)." >&2
            sleep $((attempt * 5))
          done

          if [ -z "${published}" ]; then
            echo "Could not publish to the ${DOCS_BRANCH} branch after 3 attempts." >&2
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Comment the preview link on the pull request
        if: ${{ !github.event.pull_request.head.repo.fork }}
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          PR_NUMBER: ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
          BASE_REF: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.ref }}
          HEAD_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
          RUN_URL: ${{ github.server_url }}/${{ github.repository }}/actions/runs/${{ github.run_id }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          repository="$(printf '%s' "${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}" | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]')"
          base_url="${PAGES_BASE_URL:-https://${repository%%/*}.github.io/${repository#*/}}"
          preview_url="${base_url%/}/pr/${PR_NUMBER}/"

          body="$(mktemp)"
          cat > "${body}" <<EOF
          ${PREVIEW_MARKER}
          **Documentation preview:** ${preview_url}

          Generated in diff mode against \`${BASE_REF}\`, so every page marks what this
          pull request adds, removes, and changes. The display-mode switch next to the
          theme toggle shows the plain documentation, the marked documentation, or the
          changes alone.

          Updated for ${HEAD_SHA} by [this run](${RUN_URL}). The preview is removed when
          the pull request is closed.
          EOF

          comment_id="$(gh api "repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/issues/${PR_NUMBER}/comments" --paginate \
            | jq -rs --arg marker "${PREVIEW_MARKER}" \
              'add | map(select(.body | startswith($marker))) | first | .id // empty')"

          if [ -n "${comment_id}" ]; then
            jq -n --rawfile body "${body}" '{body: $body}' \
              | gh api --method PATCH "repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/issues/comments/${comment_id}" --input - > /dev/null
            echo "Updated comment ${comment_id}."
          else
            jq -n --rawfile body "${body}" '{body: $body}' \
              | gh api --method POST "repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/issues/${PR_NUMBER}/comments" --input - > /dev/null
            echo "Commented the preview link."
          fi

  cleanup:
    name: Remove the pull request preview
    if: github.event.action == 'closed' && !github.event.pull_request.head.repo.fork
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    permissions:
      contents: write
      pull-requests: write
    steps:
      - name: Check out the repository
        uses: actions/checkout@9c091bb21b7c1c1d1991bb908d89e4e9dddfe3e0 # v7.0.0

      - name: Remove the preview from the documentation branch
        env:
          PR_NUMBER: ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
          COMMIT_MESSAGE: 'docs: remove the preview of pull request #${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}'
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          if ! git ls-remote --exit-code --heads origin "${DOCS_BRANCH}" > /dev/null; then
            echo "There is no ${DOCS_BRANCH} branch; nothing to remove."
            exit 0
          fi

          worktree="$(mktemp -d)/docs-branch"
          removed=''

          for attempt in 1 2 3; do
            rm -rf "${worktree}"
            git worktree prune

            git fetch --no-tags --depth=1 origin "+refs/heads/${DOCS_BRANCH}:refs/remotes/origin/${DOCS_BRANCH}"
            git worktree add --quiet -B "${DOCS_BRANCH}" "${worktree}" "origin/${DOCS_BRANCH}"

            rm -rf "${worktree}/pr/${PR_NUMBER}"
            rmdir "${worktree}/pr" 2> /dev/null || true

            git -C "${worktree}" add --all
            if git -C "${worktree}" diff --cached --quiet; then
              echo "The ${DOCS_BRANCH} branch carries no preview of this pull request."
              removed='unchanged'
              break
            fi

            git -C "${worktree}" \
              -c user.name='github-actions[bot]' \
              -c user.email='41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com' \
              commit --quiet --message "${COMMIT_MESSAGE}"

            if git -C "${worktree}" push --quiet origin "HEAD:refs/heads/${DOCS_BRANCH}"; then
              removed='pushed'
              break
            fi

            echo "The ${DOCS_BRANCH} branch moved while removing the preview; retrying (attempt ${attempt} of 3)." >&2
            sleep $((attempt * 5))
          done

          if [ -z "${removed}" ]; then
            echo "Could not remove the preview from the ${DOCS_BRANCH} branch after 3 attempts." >&2
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Note the removal on the pull request
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          PR_NUMBER: ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          comment_id="$(gh api "repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/issues/${PR_NUMBER}/comments" --paginate \
            | jq -rs --arg marker "${PREVIEW_MARKER}" \
              'add | map(select(.body | startswith($marker))) | first | .id // empty')"

          if [ -z "${comment_id}" ]; then
            echo "This pull request has no preview comment."
            exit 0
          fi

          body="$(mktemp)"
          cat > "${body}" <<EOF
          ${PREVIEW_MARKER}
          The documentation preview of this pull request has been removed.
          EOF

          jq -n --rawfile body "${body}" '{body: $body}' \
            | gh api --method PATCH "repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/issues/comments/${comment_id}" --input - > /dev/null

# Pull requests from forks run with a read-only token, so their preview is
# generated but not published. Publishing those needs the hardened
# `workflow_run` pattern: build on `pull_request` and upload an artifact, then
# publish it from a separate workflow that runs on the default branch. Never
# switch this workflow to `pull_request_target`; that would run untrusted code
# with a write token.
name: Docs Preview

on:
  pull_request:
    types:
      - opened
      - synchronize
      - reopened
      - closed

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

env:
  COMPOSER_NO_INTERACTION: '1'
  DOCS_BRANCH: gh-pages
  SITE_DIR: build/docs
  PREVIEW_MARKER: '<!-- doc-gen-preview -->'
  # Set to the site address when Pages serves a custom domain, such as
  # https://docs.example.com. Empty means https://<owner>.github.io/<repo>.
  PAGES_BASE_URL: ''

jobs:
  preview:
    name: Generate and publish the pull request preview
    if: github.event.action != 'closed'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    permissions:
      contents: write
      pull-requests: write
    steps:
      # Diff mode checks the base revision out into a temporary worktree, so
      # the history of both revisions has to be present.
      - name: Check out the pull request
        uses: actions/checkout@9c091bb21b7c1c1d1991bb908d89e4e9dddfe3e0 # v7.0.0
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Set up PHP
        uses: shivammathur/setup-php@f3e473d116dcccaddc5834248c87452386958240 # 2.37.2
        with:
          php-version: '8.4'
          extensions: mbstring, pcntl
          coverage: none

      - name: Install dependencies
        uses: ramsey/composer-install@65e4f84970763564f46a70b8a54b90d033b3bdda # 4.0.0
        with:
          dependency-versions: locked
          composer-options: --prefer-dist

      - name: Restore the DocGen cache
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: build/doc-gen-cache
          key: doc-gen-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('composer.lock') }}-${{ github.sha }}
          restore-keys: |
            doc-gen-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('composer.lock') }}-
            doc-gen-${{ runner.os }}-

      - name: Generate the documentation in diff mode
        env:
          BASE_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}
        run: vendor/bin/doc-gen --config=doc.yaml --diff="${BASE_SHA}"

      - name: Explain why a fork pull request is not published
        if: github.event.pull_request.head.repo.fork
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          {
            printf '## Documentation preview\n\n'
            printf 'The site was generated but not published: a pull request from a fork'
            printf ' runs with a read-only token, so it cannot write to the `%s` branch.\n' "${DOCS_BRANCH}"
          } >> "${GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY}"

      - name: Publish the preview to the documentation branch
        if: ${{ !github.event.pull_request.head.repo.fork }}
        env:
          PR_NUMBER: ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
          COMMIT_MESSAGE: 'docs: preview pull request #${{ github.event.pull_request.number }} at ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}'
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          test -f "${SITE_DIR}/index.html" || {
            echo "No generated site at ${SITE_DIR}; refusing to publish." >&2
            exit 1
          }

          site="$(cd "${SITE_DIR}" && pwd)"
          worktree="$(mktemp -d)/docs-branch"
          published=''

          # The default branch publishes to the same branch, so a run that
          # loses the race refetches the branch and replays its own change.
          for attempt in 1 2 3; do
            rm -rf "${worktree}"
            git worktree prune

            if git fetch --no-tags --depth=1 origin "+refs/heads/${DOCS_BRANCH}:refs/remotes/origin/${DOCS_BRANCH}"; then
              git worktree add --quiet -B "${DOCS_BRANCH}" "${worktree}" "origin/${DOCS_BRANCH}"
            else
              echo "Creating the ${DOCS_BRANCH} branch."
              git worktree add --quiet --detach "${worktree}"
              git -C "${worktree}" switch --quiet --orphan "${DOCS_BRANCH}"
            fi

            rm -rf "${worktree}/pr/${PR_NUMBER}"
            mkdir -p "${worktree}/pr/${PR_NUMBER}"
            cp -a "${site}/." "${worktree}/pr/${PR_NUMBER}/"
            # Jekyll is disabled for the whole site from its root, which the
            # preview may reach before the site itself has been published.
            touch "${worktree}/.nojekyll"

            git -C "${worktree}" add --all
            if git -C "${worktree}" diff --cached --quiet; then
              echo "The ${DOCS_BRANCH} branch already serves this preview."
              published='unchanged'
              break
            fi

            git -C "${worktree}" \
              -c user.name='github-actions[bot]' \
              -c user.email='41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com' \
              commit --quiet --message "${COMMIT_MESSAGE}"

            if git -C "${worktree}" push --quiet origin "HEAD:refs/heads/${DOCS_BRANCH}"; then
              published='pushed'
              break
            fi

            echo "The ${DOCS_BRANCH} branch moved while publishing; retrying (attempt ${attempt} of 3)." >&2
            sleep $((attempt * 5))
          done

          if [ -z "${published}" ]; then
            echo "Could not publish to the ${DOCS_BRANCH} branch after 3 attempts." >&2
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Comment the preview link on the pull request
        if: ${{ !github.event.pull_request.head.repo.fork }}
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          PR_NUMBER: ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
          BASE_REF: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.ref }}
          HEAD_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
          RUN_URL: ${{ github.server_url }}/${{ github.repository }}/actions/runs/${{ github.run_id }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          repository="$(printf '%s' "${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}" | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]')"
          base_url="${PAGES_BASE_URL:-https://${repository%%/*}.github.io/${repository#*/}}"
          preview_url="${base_url%/}/pr/${PR_NUMBER}/"

          body="$(mktemp)"
          cat > "${body}" <<EOF
          ${PREVIEW_MARKER}
          **Documentation preview:** ${preview_url}

          Generated in diff mode against \`${BASE_REF}\`, so every page marks what this
          pull request adds, removes, and changes. The display-mode switch next to the
          theme toggle shows the plain documentation, the marked documentation, or the
          changes alone.

          Updated for ${HEAD_SHA} by [this run](${RUN_URL}). The preview is removed when
          the pull request is closed.
          EOF

          comment_id="$(gh api "repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/issues/${PR_NUMBER}/comments" --paginate \
            | jq -rs --arg marker "${PREVIEW_MARKER}" \
              'add | map(select(.body | startswith($marker))) | first | .id // empty')"

          if [ -n "${comment_id}" ]; then
            jq -n --rawfile body "${body}" '{body: $body}' \
              | gh api --method PATCH "repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/issues/comments/${comment_id}" --input - > /dev/null
            echo "Updated comment ${comment_id}."
          else
            jq -n --rawfile body "${body}" '{body: $body}' \
              | gh api --method POST "repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/issues/${PR_NUMBER}/comments" --input - > /dev/null
            echo "Commented the preview link."
          fi

  cleanup:
    name: Remove the pull request preview
    if: github.event.action == 'closed' && !github.event.pull_request.head.repo.fork
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    permissions:
      contents: write
      pull-requests: write
    steps:
      - name: Check out the repository
        uses: actions/checkout@9c091bb21b7c1c1d1991bb908d89e4e9dddfe3e0 # v7.0.0

      - name: Remove the preview from the documentation branch
        env:
          PR_NUMBER: ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
          COMMIT_MESSAGE: 'docs: remove the preview of pull request #${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}'
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          if ! git ls-remote --exit-code --heads origin "${DOCS_BRANCH}" > /dev/null; then
            echo "There is no ${DOCS_BRANCH} branch; nothing to remove."
            exit 0
          fi

          worktree="$(mktemp -d)/docs-branch"
          removed=''

          for attempt in 1 2 3; do
            rm -rf "${worktree}"
            git worktree prune

            git fetch --no-tags --depth=1 origin "+refs/heads/${DOCS_BRANCH}:refs/remotes/origin/${DOCS_BRANCH}"
            git worktree add --quiet -B "${DOCS_BRANCH}" "${worktree}" "origin/${DOCS_BRANCH}"

            rm -rf "${worktree}/pr/${PR_NUMBER}"
            rmdir "${worktree}/pr" 2> /dev/null || true

            git -C "${worktree}" add --all
            if git -C "${worktree}" diff --cached --quiet; then
              echo "The ${DOCS_BRANCH} branch carries no preview of this pull request."
              removed='unchanged'
              break
            fi

            git -C "${worktree}" \
              -c user.name='github-actions[bot]' \
              -c user.email='41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com' \
              commit --quiet --message "${COMMIT_MESSAGE}"

            if git -C "${worktree}" push --quiet origin "HEAD:refs/heads/${DOCS_BRANCH}"; then
              removed='pushed'
              break
            fi

            echo "The ${DOCS_BRANCH} branch moved while removing the preview; retrying (attempt ${attempt} of 3)." >&2
            sleep $((attempt * 5))
          done

          if [ -z "${removed}" ]; then
            echo "Could not remove the preview from the ${DOCS_BRANCH} branch after 3 attempts." >&2
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Note the removal on the pull request
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          PR_NUMBER: ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          comment_id="$(gh api "repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/issues/${PR_NUMBER}/comments" --paginate \
            | jq -rs --arg marker "${PREVIEW_MARKER}" \
              'add | map(select(.body | startswith($marker))) | first | .id // empty')"

          if [ -z "${comment_id}" ]; then
            echo "This pull request has no preview comment."
            exit 0
          fi

          body="$(mktemp)"
          cat > "${body}" <<EOF
          ${PREVIEW_MARKER}
          The documentation preview of this pull request has been removed.
          EOF

          jq -n --rawfile body "${body}" '{body: $body}' \
            | gh api --method PATCH "repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/issues/comments/${comment_id}" --input - > /dev/null

[user]

[init]
    defaultBranch = main
CFG

git init --quiet --bare "$root/origin.git"
git clone --quiet "$root/origin.git" "$root/work"
cd "$root/work"
echo 'project' > README.md
git add README.md
git commit --quiet -m 'initial'
git push --quiet -u origin main

make_site() {
  local dir="$1" marker="$2"

  printf '<html>%s</html>\n' "$marker" > "$dir/index.html"

# Publishes the DocGen site of the default branch to GitHub Pages.
#
# One-time setup in the repository:
#   1. Settings > Pages > Build and deployment > Source: "Deploy from a branch",
#      branch "gh-pages", folder "/ (root)". The branch is created by the first
#      run of this workflow, so run the workflow once before selecting it.
#   2. Settings > Actions > General > Workflow permissions: read-only is enough;
#      this workflow requests the write permission it needs per job.
#
# The site owns the root of the documentation branch. Everything else at that
# root is replaced on every run, except `pr/` (pull request previews written by
# docs-preview.yml) and `CNAME` (a custom Pages domain).
name: Docs

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

env:
  COMPOSER_NO_INTERACTION: '1'
  DOCS_BRANCH: gh-pages
  SITE_DIR: build/docs

jobs:
  publish:
    name: Generate and publish the documentation site
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    permissions:
      contents: write
    steps:
      - name: Check out the repository
        uses: actions/checkout@9c091bb21b7c1c1d1991bb908d89e4e9dddfe3e0 # v7.0.0

      - name: Set up PHP
        uses: shivammathur/setup-php@f3e473d116dcccaddc5834248c87452386958240 # 2.37.2
        with:
          php-version: '8.4'
          extensions: mbstring, pcntl
          coverage: none

      - name: Install dependencies
        uses: ramsey/composer-install@65e4f84970763564f46a70b8a54b90d033b3bdda # 4.0.0
        with:
          dependency-versions: locked
          composer-options: --prefer-dist

      - name: Restore the DocGen cache
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: build/doc-gen-cache
          key: doc-gen-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('composer.lock') }}-${{ github.sha }}
          restore-keys: |
            doc-gen-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('composer.lock') }}-
            doc-gen-${{ runner.os }}-

      # Add `--coverage=build/coverage-xml` after a coverage run when the site
      # should link every method to the test cases that cover it.
      - name: Generate the documentation
        run: vendor/bin/doc-gen --config=doc.yaml

      - name: Publish the site to the documentation branch
        env:
          COMMIT_MESSAGE: 'docs: generate from ${{ github.sha }}'
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          test -f "${SITE_DIR}/index.html" || {
            echo "No generated site at ${SITE_DIR}; refusing to publish." >&2
            exit 1
          }

          site="$(cd "${SITE_DIR}" && pwd)"
          worktree="$(mktemp -d)/docs-branch"
          published=''

          # The pull request previews push to the same branch, so a run that
          # loses the race refetches the branch and replays its own change.
          for attempt in 1 2 3; do
            rm -rf "${worktree}"
            git worktree prune

            if git fetch --no-tags --depth=1 origin "+refs/heads/${DOCS_BRANCH}:refs/remotes/origin/${DOCS_BRANCH}"; then
              git worktree add --quiet -B "${DOCS_BRANCH}" "${worktree}" "origin/${DOCS_BRANCH}"
            else
              echo "Creating the ${DOCS_BRANCH} branch."
              git worktree add --quiet --detach "${worktree}"
              git -C "${worktree}" switch --quiet --orphan "${DOCS_BRANCH}"
            fi

            find "${worktree}" -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 \
              ! -name '.git' ! -name 'pr' ! -name 'CNAME' -exec rm -rf {} +
            cp -a "${site}/." "${worktree}/"
            touch "${worktree}/.nojekyll"

              echo "The ${DOCS_BRANCH} branch already serves this documentation."
              published='unchanged'
              break
            fi

              -c user.name='github-actions[bot]' \
              -c user.email='41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com' \
              commit --quiet --message "${COMMIT_MESSAGE}"

            if git -C "${worktree}" push --quiet origin "HEAD:refs/heads/${DOCS_BRANCH}"; then
              published='pushed'
              break
            fi

            echo "The ${DOCS_BRANCH} branch moved while publishing; retrying (attempt ${attempt} of 3)." >&2
            sleep $((attempt * 5))
          done

          if [ -z "${published}" ]; then
            echo "Could not publish to the ${DOCS_BRANCH} branch after 3 attempts." >&2
            exit 1
          fi

        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          repository="$(printf '%s' "${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}" | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]')"
          {
            printf '## Documentation\n\n'

import pathlib

report_old = """            printf 'Published to the `%s` branch: https://%s.github.io/%s/\\n' \\"""
report_new = """            printf "Published to the \\`%s\\` branch: https://%s.github.io/%s/\\n" \\"""

fork_old = """            printf ' runs with a read-only token, so it cannot write to the `%s` branch.\\n' "${DOCS_BRANCH}\""""
fork_new = """            printf " runs with a read-only token, so it cannot write to the \\`%s\\` branch.\\n" "${DOCS_BRANCH}\""""

for path, old, new in [
    ('.github/workflows/docs.yml', report_old, report_new),
    ('skills/setup-toolkit-doc-gen/docs.yml', report_old, report_new),
    ('skills/setup-toolkit-doc-gen/docs-preview.yml', fork_old, fork_new),
]:
    p = pathlib.Path(path)
    s = p.read_text()
    assert s.count(old) == 1, (path, s.count(old))
    p.write_text(s.replace(old, new))
    print('patched', path)
PY

1	# Publishes a per-pull-request DocGen preview, generated in diff mode against
2	# the base branch, next to the published site, and links it from the pull
3	# request. Closing the pull request removes the preview again.
4	#
5	# Requires docs.yml (or an equivalent) to own the root of the documentation
6	# branch: this workflow only ever writes below `pr/<number>/`.
7	#
8	# Pull requests from forks run with a read-only token, so their preview is
9	# generated but not published. Publishing those needs the hardened
10	# `workflow_run` pattern: build on `pull_request` and upload an artifact, then
11	# publish it from a separate workflow that runs on the default branch. Never
12	# switch this workflow to `pull_request_target`; that would run untrusted code
13	# with a write token.
14	name: Docs Preview
15	
16	on:
17	  pull_request:
18	    types:
19	      - opened
20	      - synchronize
21	      - reopened
22	      - closed
23	
24	permissions:
25	  contents: read
26	
27	concurrency:
28	  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
29	  cancel-in-progress: true
30	
31	env:
32	  COMPOSER_NO_INTERACTION: '1'
33	  DOCS_BRANCH: gh-pages
34	  SITE_DIR: build/docs
35	  PREVIEW_MARKER: '<!-- doc-gen-preview -->'
36	  # Set to the site address when Pages serves a custom domain, such as
37	  # https://docs.example.com. Empty means https://<owner>.github.io/<repo>.
38	  PAGES_BASE_URL: ''
39	
40	jobs:
41	  preview:
42	    name: Generate and publish the pull request preview
43	    if: github.event.action != 'closed'
44	    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
45	    timeout-minutes: 30
46	    permissions:
47	      contents: write
48	      pull-requests: write
49	    steps:
50	      # Diff mode checks the base revision out into a temporary worktree, so
51	      # the history of both revisions has to be present.
52	      - name: Check out the pull request
53	        uses: actions/checkout@9c091bb21b7c1c1d1991bb908d89e4e9dddfe3e0 # v7.0.0
54	        with:
55	          fetch-depth: 0
56	
57	      - name: Set up PHP
58	        uses: shivammathur/setup-php@f3e473d116dcccaddc5834248c87452386958240 # 2.37.2
59	        with:
60	          php-version: '8.4'
61	          extensions: mbstring, pcntl
62	          coverage: none
63	
64	      - name: Install dependencies
65	        uses: ramsey/composer-install@65e4f84970763564f46a70b8a54b90d033b3bdda # 4.0.0
66	        with:
67	          dependency-versions: locked
68	          composer-options: --prefer-dist
69	
70	      - name: Restore the DocGen cache
71	        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
72	        with:
73	          path: build/doc-gen-cache
74	          key: doc-gen-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('composer.lock') }}-${{ github.sha }}
75	          restore-keys: |
76	            doc-gen-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('composer.lock') }}-
77	            doc-gen-${{ runner.os }}-
78	
79	      - name: Generate the documentation in diff mode
80	        env:
81	          BASE_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}
82	        run: vendor/bin/doc-gen --config=doc.yaml --diff="${BASE_SHA}"
83	
84	      - name: Explain why a fork pull request is not published
85	        if: github.event.pull_request.head.repo.fork
86	        run: |
87	          set -euo pipefail
88	
89	          {
90	            printf '## Documentation preview\n\n'
91	            printf 'The site was generated but not published: a pull request from a fork'
92	            printf " runs with a read-only token, so it cannot write to the \`%s\` branch.\n" "${DOCS_BRANCH}"
93	          } >> "${GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY}"
94	
95	      - name: Publish the preview to the documentation branch
96	        if: ${{ !github.event.pull_request.head.repo.fork }}
97	        env:
98	          PR_NUMBER: ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
99	          COMMIT_MESSAGE: 'docs: preview pull request #${{ github.event.pull_request.number }} at ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}'
100	        run: |
101	          set -euo pipefail
102	
103	          test -f "${SITE_DIR}/index.html" || {
104	            echo "No generated site at ${SITE_DIR}; refusing to publish." >&2
105	            exit 1
106	          }
107	
108	          site="$(cd "${SITE_DIR}" && pwd)"
109	          worktree="$(mktemp -d)/docs-branch"
110	          author_name='github-actions[bot]'
111	          author_email='41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com'
112	          published=''

114	          # The default branch publishes to the same branch, so a run that
115	          # loses the race refetches the branch and replays its own change.
116	          for attempt in 1 2 3; do
117	            rm -rf "${worktree}"
118	            git worktree prune
119	
120	            if git fetch --no-tags --depth=1 origin "+refs/heads/${DOCS_BRANCH}:refs/remotes/origin/${DOCS_BRANCH}"; then
121	              start="origin/${DOCS_BRANCH}"

124	              start="$(git -c user.name="${author_name}" -c user.email="${author_email}" \

142	            fi

147	            if git -C "${worktree}" push --quiet origin "HEAD:refs/heads/${DOCS_BRANCH}"; then
148	              published='pushed'
149	              break
150	            fi
151	
152	            echo "The ${DOCS_BRANCH} branch moved while publishing; retrying (attempt ${attempt} of 3)." >&2
153	            sleep $((attempt * 5))
154	          done
155	
156	          rm -rf "${worktree}"

1	# Publishes the DocGen site of the default branch to GitHub Pages.
2	#
3	# One-time setup in the repository:
4	#   1. Settings > Pages > Build and deployment > Source: "Deploy from a branch",
5	#      branch "gh-pages", folder "/ (root)". The branch is created by the first
6	#      run of this workflow, so run the workflow once before selecting it.
7	#   2. Settings > Actions > General > Workflow permissions: read-only is enough;
8	#      this workflow requests the write permission it needs per job.
9	#
10	# The site owns the root of the documentation branch. Everything else at that
11	# root is replaced on every run, except `pr/` (pull request previews written by
12	# docs-preview.yml) and `CNAME` (a custom Pages domain).
13	name: Docs
14	
15	on:
16	  push:
17	    branches:
18	      - main
19	  workflow_dispatch:
20	
21	permissions:
22	  contents: read
23	
24	concurrency:
25	  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
26	  cancel-in-progress: false

name: Docs

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

env:
  COMPOSER_NO_INTERACTION: '1'
  DOCS_BRANCH: gh-pages
  SITE_DIR: build/docs

jobs:
  publish:
    name: Generate and publish the documentation site
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    permissions:
      contents: write
    steps:
      - name: Check out the repository
        uses: actions/checkout@9c091bb21b7c1c1d1991bb908d89e4e9dddfe3e0 # v7.0.0

      - name: Set up PHP
        uses: shivammathur/setup-php@f3e473d116dcccaddc5834248c87452386958240 # 2.37.2
        with:
          php-version: '8.4'
          extensions: mbstring, pcntl
          coverage: none

      - name: Select the matching lock file
        run: cp composer.lock.php-8.4 composer.lock

      - name: Install dependencies
        uses: ramsey/composer-install@65e4f84970763564f46a70b8a54b90d033b3bdda # 4.0.0
        with:
          dependency-versions: locked
          composer-options: --prefer-dist

      - name: Restore the DocGen cache
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: build/doc-gen-cache
          key: doc-gen-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('composer.lock.php-8.4') }}-${{ github.sha }}
          restore-keys: |
            doc-gen-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('composer.lock.php-8.4') }}-
            doc-gen-${{ runner.os }}-

      - name: Generate the documentation
        run: composer doc-gen

      - name: Publish the site to the documentation branch
        env:
          COMMIT_MESSAGE: 'docs: generate from ${{ github.sha }}'
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          test -f "${SITE_DIR}/index.html" || {
            echo "No generated site at ${SITE_DIR}; refusing to publish." >&2
            exit 1
          }

          site="$(cd "${SITE_DIR}" && pwd)"
          worktree="$(mktemp -d)/docs-branch"
          author_name='github-actions[bot]'
          author_email='41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com'
          published=''

          # A run that loses a push race refetches the branch and replays its
          # own change onto it.
          for attempt in 1 2 3; do
            rm -rf "${worktree}"
            git worktree prune

            if git fetch --no-tags --depth=1 origin "+refs/heads/${DOCS_BRANCH}:refs/remotes/origin/${DOCS_BRANCH}"; then
              start="origin/${DOCS_BRANCH}"
            else
              echo "Creating the ${DOCS_BRANCH} branch."
              start="$(git -c user.name="${author_name}" -c user.email="${author_email}" \
                commit-tree -m 'docs: create the documentation branch' "$(git hash-object -w -t tree /dev/null)")"
            fi

            git worktree add --quiet --detach "${worktree}" "${start}"

            # The site owns the root of the branch; the pull request previews
            # under pr/ and a custom Pages domain in CNAME are kept.
            find "${worktree}" -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 \
              ! -name '.git' ! -name 'pr' ! -name 'CNAME' -exec rm -rf {} +
            cp -a "${site}/." "${worktree}/"
            touch "${worktree}/.nojekyll"

            git -C "${worktree}" add --all
            if git -C "${worktree}" diff --cached --quiet; then
              echo "The ${DOCS_BRANCH} branch already serves this documentation."
              published='unchanged'
              break
            fi

            git -C "${worktree}" -c user.name="${author_name}" -c user.email="${author_email}" \
              commit --quiet --message "${COMMIT_MESSAGE}"

            if git -C "${worktree}" push --quiet origin "HEAD:refs/heads/${DOCS_BRANCH}"; then
              published='pushed'
              break
            fi

            echo "The ${DOCS_BRANCH} branch moved while publishing; retrying (attempt ${attempt} of 3)." >&2
            sleep $((attempt * 5))
          done

          rm -rf "${worktree}"
          git worktree prune

          if [ -z "${published}" ]; then
            echo "Could not publish to the ${DOCS_BRANCH} branch after 3 attempts." >&2
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Report the published site
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          repository="$(printf '%s' "${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}" | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]')"
          {
            printf '## Documentation\n\n'
            printf "Published to the \`%s\` branch: https://%s.github.io/%s/\n" \
              "${DOCS_BRANCH}" "${repository%%/*}" "${repository#*/}"
          } >> "${GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY}"

            git worktree add --quiet --detach "${worktree}" "${start}"

            # The site owns the root of the branch; the pull request previews
            # under pr/ and a custom Pages domain in CNAME are kept.

              ! -name '.git' ! -name 'pr' ! -name 'CNAME' -exec rm -rf {} +
            cp -a "${site}/." "${worktree}/"

            git -C "${worktree}" add --all

          git worktree prune

            echo "Could not publish to the ${DOCS_BRANCH} branch after 3 attempts." >&2
            exit 1
          fi

        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          repository="$(printf '%s' "${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}" | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]')"
          {
            printf '## Documentation\n\n'
            printf "Published to the \`%s\` branch: https://%s.github.io/%s/\n" \

# Publishes a per-pull-request DocGen preview, generated in diff mode against
# the base branch, under `pr/<number>/` of the documentation branch, and links
# it from the pull request. Closing the pull request removes it again.
#
# Requires docs.yml (or an equivalent) to own the root of that branch: this
# workflow only ever writes below `pr/<number>/`.
#
# Pull requests from forks are skipped: they run with a read-only token, so
# they cannot write to the branch or comment. Publishing those needs the
# hardened `workflow_run` pattern — build on `pull_request` and upload an
# artifact, then publish it from a workflow that runs on the default branch.
# Never switch this workflow to `pull_request_target`; that would run
# untrusted code with a write token.
name: Docs Preview

on:
  pull_request:
    types:
      - opened
      - synchronize
      - reopened
      - closed

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

env:
  COMPOSER_NO_INTERACTION: '1'
  DOCS_BRANCH: gh-pages

jobs:
  preview:
    name: Generate and publish the pull request preview
    if: github.event.action != 'closed' && !github.event.pull_request.head.repo.fork
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    permissions:
      contents: write
      pull-requests: write
    steps:
      # Diff mode checks the base revision out into a temporary worktree, so
      # the history of both revisions has to be present.
      - name: Check out the pull request
        uses: actions/checkout@9c091bb21b7c1c1d1991bb908d89e4e9dddfe3e0 # v7.0.0
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Set up PHP
        uses: shivammathur/setup-php@f3e473d116dcccaddc5834248c87452386958240 # 2.37.2
        with:
          php-version: '8.4'
          extensions: mbstring, pcntl
          coverage: none

      - name: Install dependencies
        uses: ramsey/composer-install@65e4f84970763564f46a70b8a54b90d033b3bdda # 4.0.0
        with:
          dependency-versions: locked
          composer-options: --prefer-dist

      - name: Restore the DocGen cache
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: build/doc-gen-cache
          key: doc-gen-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('composer.lock') }}-${{ github.sha }}
          restore-keys: |
            doc-gen-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('composer.lock') }}-
            doc-gen-${{ runner.os }}-

      # The checkout is the merge of the pull request into its base, so
      # comparing it against the base commit is what the pull request changes.
      - name: Generate the documentation in diff mode
        env:
          BASE_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}
        run: vendor/bin/doc-gen --config=doc.yaml --diff="${BASE_SHA}"

      - name: Check out the documentation branch
        uses: actions/checkout@9c091bb21b7c1c1d1991bb908d89e4e9dddfe3e0 # v7.0.0
        with:
          ref: ${{ env.DOCS_BRANCH }}
          path: .docs-branch

      - name: Publish the preview
        working-directory: .docs-branch
        env:
          PR_NUMBER: ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
          HEAD_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          mkdir -p "pr/${PR_NUMBER}"
          rsync -a --delete ../build/docs/ "pr/${PR_NUMBER}/"
          # Jekyll is disabled for the whole site from its root, which the
          # preview may reach before the site itself has been published.
          touch .nojekyll

          git add --all
          if git diff --cached --quiet; then
            echo "The ${DOCS_BRANCH} branch already serves this preview."
            exit 0
          fi

          git -c user.name='github-actions[bot]' \
            -c user.email='41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com' \
            commit --message "docs: preview pull request #${PR_NUMBER} at ${HEAD_SHA}"
          git push origin "HEAD:${DOCS_BRANCH}"

      - name: Comment the preview link on the pull request
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          PR_NUMBER: ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
          BASE_REF: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.ref }}
          HEAD_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          # Replace this with the site address when Pages serves a custom domain.
          repository="$(printf '%s' "${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}" | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]')"
          preview_url="https://${repository%%/*}.github.io/${repository#*/}/pr/${PR_NUMBER}/"

          gh pr comment "${PR_NUMBER}" --edit-last --create-if-none --body \
          "**Documentation preview:** ${preview_url}

          Generated in diff mode against \`${BASE_REF}\`, so every page marks what this pull
          request adds, removes, and changes; the display-mode switch next to the theme
          toggle shows the plain documentation, the marked documentation, or the changes
          alone.

          Updated for ${HEAD_SHA}. The preview is removed when this pull request is closed."

  cleanup:
    name: Remove the pull request preview
    if: github.event.action == 'closed' && !github.event.pull_request.head.repo.fork
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    permissions:
      contents: write
      pull-requests: write
    steps:
      - name: Check out the documentation branch
        uses: actions/checkout@9c091bb21b7c1c1d1991bb908d89e4e9dddfe3e0 # v7.0.0
        with:
          ref: ${{ env.DOCS_BRANCH }}

      - name: Remove the preview
        env:
          PR_NUMBER: ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          rm -rf "pr/${PR_NUMBER}"

          git add --all
          if git diff --cached --quiet; then
            echo "The ${DOCS_BRANCH} branch carries no preview of this pull request."
            exit 0
          fi

          git -c user.name='github-actions[bot]' \
            -c user.email='41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com' \
            commit --message "docs: remove the preview of pull request #${PR_NUMBER}"
          git push origin "HEAD:${DOCS_BRANCH}"

      - name: Note the removal on the pull request
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          PR_NUMBER: ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
        run: |
          gh pr comment "${PR_NUMBER}" --edit-last --body \
            'The documentation preview of this pull request has been removed.' \
            || echo 'This pull request has no preview comment.'

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

here="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)"
root="$here/sandbox"
rm -rf "$root"
mkdir -p "$root"

export GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL="$root/gitconfig"
export GIT_CONFIG_SYSTEM=/dev/null
cat > "$GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL" <<'CFG'
[user]
    name = Sandbox
    email = sandbox@example.com
[init]
    defaultBranch = main
CFG

git init --quiet --bare "$root/origin.git"
git clone --quiet "$root/origin.git" "$root/work"
cd "$root/work"
echo 'project' > README.md
git add README.md
git commit --quiet -m 'initial'
git push --quiet -u origin main

# The documented one-time setup of the documentation branch.
git switch --quiet --orphan gh-pages
git commit --quiet --allow-empty -m 'docs: create the documentation branch'
git push --quiet -u origin gh-pages
git switch --quiet -

make_site() {
  local dir="$1" marker="$2"
  rm -rf "$dir"
  mkdir -p "$dir/assets" "$dir/pkg"
  printf '<html>%s</html>\n' "$marker" > "$dir/index.html"
  printf 'body{}\n' > "$dir/assets/style.css"
  printf '<html>%s page</html>\n' "$marker" > "$dir/pkg/class.html"
  : > "$dir/.nojekyll"
}

# Stands in for `actions/checkout` with `ref: gh-pages`.
checkout_docs_branch() {
  local path="$1"
  rm -rf "$path"
  git clone --quiet --depth=1 --branch gh-pages "$root/origin.git" "$path"
}

run() {
  local script="$1" workdir="$2"
  shift 2
  (cd "$workdir" && env "$@" bash "$here/$script")
}

banner() { printf '\n=== %s ===\n' "$1"; }

branch_files() {
  git -C "$root/work" fetch --quiet origin '+refs/heads/gh-pages:refs/remotes/origin/gh-pages'
  git -C "$root/work" ls-tree -r --name-only origin/gh-pages | sort
}

banner '1. the first publish fills the empty branch'
make_site "$root/work/build/docs" v1
checkout_docs_branch "$root/work/.docs-branch"
run publish-main.sh "$root/work/.docs-branch" DOCS_BRANCH=gh-pages GITHUB_SHA=1111111
branch_files

banner '2. publishing the same site again changes nothing'
checkout_docs_branch "$root/work/.docs-branch"
run publish-main.sh "$root/work/.docs-branch" DOCS_BRANCH=gh-pages GITHUB_SHA=1111111

banner '3. a preview is published under pr/7'
make_site "$root/work/build/docs" pr7
checkout_docs_branch "$root/work/.docs-branch"
run publish-preview.sh "$root/work/.docs-branch" DOCS_BRANCH=gh-pages PR_NUMBER=7 HEAD_SHA=abcdef1
branch_files

banner '4. the next site publish keeps pr/7 and CNAME and drops a stale page'
checkout_docs_branch "$root/branch"
printf 'docs.example.com\n' > "$root/branch/CNAME"
printf 'stale\n' > "$root/branch/stale.html"
git -C "$root/branch" add --all
git -C "$root/branch" commit --quiet -m 'add CNAME and a stale page'
git -C "$root/branch" push --quiet origin HEAD:gh-pages
make_site "$root/work/build/docs" v2
checkout_docs_branch "$root/work/.docs-branch"
run publish-main.sh "$root/work/.docs-branch" DOCS_BRANCH=gh-pages GITHUB_SHA=2222222
branch_files
printf 'root index: '
git -C "$root/work" show origin/gh-pages:index.html
printf 'pr/7 index: '
git -C "$root/work" show origin/gh-pages:pr/7/index.html

banner '5. closing the pull request removes pr/7 only'
mkdir -p "$root/work/.docs-branch-2"
checkout_docs_branch "$root/work/.docs-branch-2"
run cleanup-preview.sh "$root/work/.docs-branch-2" DOCS_BRANCH=gh-pages PR_NUMBER=7
branch_files

banner '6. closing it again removes nothing'
checkout_docs_branch "$root/work/.docs-branch-2"
run cleanup-preview.sh "$root/work/.docs-branch-2" DOCS_BRANCH=gh-pages PR_NUMBER=7

banner 'all sandbox checks completed'

# Publishes the DocGen site of the default branch to GitHub Pages.
#
# One-time setup in the repository:
#   1. Create the empty documentation branch:
#        git switch --orphan gh-pages
#        git commit --allow-empty -m 'docs: create the documentation branch'
#        git push -u origin gh-pages
#        git switch -
#   2. Settings > Pages > Build and deployment > Source: "Deploy from a branch",
#      branch "gh-pages", folder "/ (root)".
#
# The site owns the root of that branch: everything else there is replaced on
# every run, except `pr/` (previews written by docs-preview.yml) and `CNAME`
# (a custom Pages domain).
name: Docs

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

env:
  COMPOSER_NO_INTERACTION: '1'
  DOCS_BRANCH: gh-pages

jobs:
  publish:
    name: Generate and publish the documentation site
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    permissions:
      contents: write
    steps:
      - name: Check out the repository
        uses: actions/checkout@9c091bb21b7c1c1d1991bb908d89e4e9dddfe3e0 # v7.0.0

      - name: Set up PHP
        uses: shivammathur/setup-php@f3e473d116dcccaddc5834248c87452386958240 # 2.37.2
        with:
          php-version: '8.4'
          extensions: mbstring, pcntl
          coverage: none

      - name: Install dependencies
        uses: ramsey/composer-install@65e4f84970763564f46a70b8a54b90d033b3bdda # 4.0.0
        with:
          dependency-versions: locked
          composer-options: --prefer-dist

      - name: Restore the DocGen cache
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: build/doc-gen-cache
          key: doc-gen-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('composer.lock') }}-${{ github.sha }}
          restore-keys: |
            doc-gen-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('composer.lock') }}-
            doc-gen-${{ runner.os }}-

      # Add `--coverage=build/coverage-xml` after a coverage run when the site
      # should link every method to the test cases that cover it.
      - name: Generate the documentation
        run: vendor/bin/doc-gen --config=doc.yaml

      - name: Check out the documentation branch
        uses: actions/checkout@9c091bb21b7c1c1d1991bb908d89e4e9dddfe3e0 # v7.0.0
        with:
          ref: ${{ env.DOCS_BRANCH }}
          path: .docs-branch

      - name: Publish the site
        working-directory: .docs-branch
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          # The site owns the root of the branch; the pull request previews
          # under pr/ and a custom Pages domain in CNAME are kept.
          rsync -a --delete --exclude '/.git/' --exclude '/pr/' --exclude '/CNAME' ../build/docs/ ./

          git add --all
          if git diff --cached --quiet; then
            echo "The ${DOCS_BRANCH} branch already serves this documentation."
            exit 0
          fi

          git -c user.name='github-actions[bot]' \
            -c user.email='41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com' \
            commit --message "docs: generate from ${GITHUB_SHA}"
          git push origin "HEAD:${DOCS_BRANCH}"

description: >-

  publish generated PHP documentation.

# Setup DocGen (Static Documentation Site)

This skill configures `doc-gen`, the php-ai-toolkit CLI that generates a dense, fully cross-linked static HTML
documentation site — complete types, interface implementations, call sites, architecture layers, coverage-backed
test references, runnable doctest examples, and an optional comparison of two git revisions — for the composer
packages of a project.

## Prerequisites

Inspect `composer.json` before configuring:

- Confirm the target project requires `k-kinzal/php-ai-toolkit`.
- Read the Composer PSR-4 autoload maps; they define exactly what gets documented.
- Check whether the repository is a monorepo (`packages/*/composer.json`) or a single package.
- Check for existing documentation config such as `doc.yaml` or a docs build step.

Install the toolkit if missing:

```bash
composer require --dev k-kinzal/php-ai-toolkit
```

## Template

Read the template from `vendor/k-kinzal/php-ai-toolkit/skills/setup-toolkit-doc-gen/doc.yaml` and apply it to the
project root as `doc.yaml`.

| Setting | Default | Meaning |
|---------|---------|---------|
| `packages` | `['.', 'packages/*']` | Directory globs probed for a `composer.json`; each hit becomes a documented package. |
| `vendor` | `[]` | Composer package-name globs (`acme/*`, not directory names) of installed **runtime** dependencies to document alongside the project. |
| `vendor_dev` | `[]` | The same for installed **dev** dependencies; keep it empty unless the test tooling itself needs documenting. |
| `exclude` | `[]` | Path globs, relative to the project root, pruned from source scanning. |
| `output` | `build/docs` | Site output directory. |
| `cache` | `build/doc-gen-cache` | Directory the parsed sources and written pages are remembered in; `false` turns caching off. Keep it outside `output`. |

The optional keys `title`, `deptrac`, and `coverage` override the site title, the deptrac config used for the
architecture layer graph (auto-detected at `deptrac.yaml`), and the PHPUnit `--coverage-xml` report directory used
for per-method test references.

## Scope Semantics

The documented unit is the composer package: production autoload sources become API pages while `autoload-dev`
sources become linkable source pages only, so test references stay navigable without widening the API surface.
Page content and design are fixed by the generator on purpose — only the scope is configurable.

## Adapting to the Project

- Single-package repositories need no `packages` change; the `packages/*` glob simply matches nothing.
- Add `exclude` globs for fixture directories that contain intentionally invalid PHP (for example `tests/Fixture/*`).
- To document key dependencies too, set `vendor` to specific composer package name globs such as `['acme/*']` rather
  than `['*']`; a glob that documents no installed package of that kind is reported as a warning, so typos surface at
  once. Dev tooling is excluded unless a `vendor_dev` glob asks for it.
- Documenting a dependency is what makes its classes link targets in signatures and type expressions, so add the
  packages whose types appear in the public API. Packages that ship only a phar cannot be documented and say so in a
  warning.
- Documenting many vendor packages needs memory: the run raises a limit below 512M automatically, and
  `--memory-limit=1G` handles very large dependency trees.
- When the project runs deptrac, keep `deptrac.yaml` at the root so the architecture graph appears automatically.
- Generate coverage with `--coverage-xml build/coverage-xml` and set `coverage: build/coverage-xml` so every method
  links the test cases that cover it.
- Runs are incremental by default: the next run parses only the sources that changed and rewrites only the pages
  that changed, and reports what it reused (`Cache: 861 of 862 sources and 1365 of 1411 pages reused`). The site is
  the same site a full run writes, byte for byte. Use `--no-cache` to prove that on demand, `--clear-cache` to start
  over, and `--cache-dir=DIR` to keep the cache elsewhere. Add the cache directory to `.gitignore`.
- In CI, restore the cache directory between runs (for example with `actions/cache` keyed on `composer.lock` and the
  toolkit version) so a documentation job costs the size of the change rather than the size of the project.
- To review what a branch changed, generate the site in diff mode: `--diff=main` compares the working tree against
  `main`, `--diff=v1.0.0..HEAD` compares two revisions. The site then marks additions and removals down to the single
  argument of a declaration and offers three display modes — the plain documentation, the marked documentation, and
  the changes alone. Diff mode needs a git working tree and analyzes both revisions, so it takes about twice as long.

## Recommended Composer Scripts

Add scripts that match the project:

```json
{
    "scripts": {
        "doc-gen": "doc-gen --config=doc.yaml",
        "doc-gen:serve": "doc-gen --config=doc.yaml --serve",
        "doc-gen:diff": "doc-gen --config=doc.yaml --diff=main --serve",
        "doc-gen:fresh": "doc-gen --config=doc.yaml --no-cache"
    }
}
```

Do not add `doc-gen` to `lint`; it is a generator, not a check. For GitHub Pages, publish the `output` directory
(the site is fully static and already contains `.nojekyll`).

## Verification

After applying:

```bash
vendor/bin/doc-gen --config=doc.yaml
```

Exit codes:

- `0`: documentation generated
- `2`: configuration or runtime error

Then preview locally with `vendor/bin/doc-gen --serve` and spot-check the index page, one class page, and search.

# Setup DocGen (Static Documentation Site)

This skill configures `doc-gen`, the php-ai-toolkit CLI that generates a dense, fully cross-linked static HTML
documentation site — complete types, interface implementations, call sites, architecture layers, coverage-backed
test references, runnable doctest examples, and an optional comparison of two git revisions — for the composer
packages of a project.

## Prerequisites

Inspect `composer.json` before configuring:

- Confirm the target project requires `k-kinzal/php-ai-toolkit`.
- Read the Composer PSR-4 autoload maps; they define exactly what gets documented.
- Check whether the repository is a monorepo (`packages/*/composer.json`) or a single package.
- Check for existing documentation config such as `doc.yaml` or a docs build step.

Install the toolkit if missing:

```bash
composer require --dev k-kinzal/php-ai-toolkit
```

## Template

Read the template from `vendor/k-kinzal/php-ai-toolkit/skills/setup-toolkit-doc-gen/doc.yaml` and apply it to the
project root as `doc.yaml`.

| Setting | Default | Meaning |
|---------|---------|---------|
| `packages` | `['.', 'packages/*']` | Directory globs probed for a `composer.json`; each hit becomes a documented package. |
| `vendor` | `[]` | Composer package-name globs (`acme/*`, not directory names) of installed **runtime** dependencies to document alongside the project. |
| `vendor_dev` | `[]` | The same for installed **dev** dependencies; keep it empty unless the test tooling itself needs documenting. |
| `exclude` | `[]` | Path globs, relative to the project root, pruned from source scanning. |
| `output` | `build/docs` | Site output directory. |
| `cache` | `build/doc-gen-cache` | Directory the parsed sources and written pages are remembered in; `false` turns caching off. Keep it outside `output`. |

The optional keys `title`, `deptrac`, and `coverage` override the site title, the deptrac config used for the
architecture layer graph (auto-detected at `deptrac.yaml`), and the PHPUnit `--coverage-xml` report directory used
for per-method test references.

## Scope Semantics

The documented unit is the composer package: production autoload sources become API pages while `autoload-dev`
sources become linkable source pages only, so test references stay navigable without widening the API surface.
Page content and design are fixed by the generator on purpose — only the scope is configurable.

## Adapting to the Project

- Single-package repositories need no `packages` change; the `packages/*` glob simply matches nothing.
- Add `exclude` globs for fixture directories that contain intentionally invalid PHP (for example `tests/Fixture/*`).
- To document key dependencies too, set `vendor` to specific composer package name globs such as `['acme/*']` rather
  than `['*']`; a glob that documents no installed package of that kind is reported as a warning, so typos surface at
  once. Dev tooling is excluded unless a `vendor_dev` glob asks for it.
- Documenting a dependency is what makes its classes link targets in signatures and type expressions, so add the
  packages whose types appear in the public API. Packages that ship only a phar cannot be documented and say so in a
  warning.
- Documenting many vendor packages needs memory: the run raises a limit below 512M automatically, and
  `--memory-limit=1G` handles very large dependency trees.
- When the project runs deptrac, keep `deptrac.yaml` at the root so the architecture graph appears automatically.
- Generate coverage with `--coverage-xml build/coverage-xml` and set `coverage: build/coverage-xml` so every method
  links the test cases that cover it.
- Runs are incremental by default: the next run parses only the sources that changed and rewrites only the pages
  that changed, and reports what it reused (`Cache: 861 of 862 sources and 1365 of 1411 pages reused`). The site is
  the same site a full run writes, byte for byte. Use `--no-cache` to prove that on demand, `--clear-cache` to start
  over, and `--cache-dir=DIR` to keep the cache elsewhere. Add the cache directory to `.gitignore`.
- In CI, restore the cache directory between runs (for example with `actions/cache` keyed on `composer.lock` and the
  toolkit version) so a documentation job costs the size of the change rather than the size of the project.
- To review what a branch changed, generate the site in diff mode: `--diff=main` compares the working tree against
  `main`, `--diff=v1.0.0..HEAD` compares two revisions. The site then marks additions and removals down to the single
  argument of a declaration and offers three display modes — the plain documentation, the marked documentation, and
  the changes alone. Diff mode needs a git working tree and analyzes both revisions, so it takes about twice as long.

## Recommended Composer Scripts

Add scripts that match the project:

```json
{
    "scripts": {
        "doc-gen": "doc-gen --config=doc.yaml",
        "doc-gen:serve": "doc-gen --config=doc.yaml --serve",
        "doc-gen:diff": "doc-gen --config=doc.yaml --diff=main --serve",
        "doc-gen:fresh": "doc-gen --config=doc.yaml --no-cache"
    }
}
```

Do not add `doc-gen` to `lint`; it is a generator, not a check. For GitHub Pages, publish the `output` directory
(the site is fully static and already contains `.nojekyll`).

## Verification

After applying:

```bash
vendor/bin/doc-gen --config=doc.yaml
```

Exit codes:

- `0`: documentation generated
- `2`: configuration or runtime error

Then preview locally with `vendor/bin/doc-gen --serve` and spot-check the index page, one class page, and search.

## Publishing

The site is published by committing the output directory to a branch GitHub Pages serves. Two workflow templates
ship with the `/setup-toolkit-doc-gen` skill, in
`vendor/k-kinzal/php-ai-toolkit/skills/setup-toolkit-doc-gen/`:

| Template | Trigger | What it does |
|----------|---------|--------------|
| `docs.yml` | push to the default branch | Generates the site and syncs it to the root of `gh-pages`, keeping `pr/` and `CNAME` |
| `docs-preview.yml` | pull request opened, updated, reopened, or closed | Generates the site in diff mode against the base commit into `pr/<number>/`, comments the link on the pull request, and removes the directory when the pull request closes |

Both check the documentation branch out with a second `actions/checkout`, sync into it with one `rsync --checksum
--delete`, and commit only when the sync changed something. `docs.yml` owns the root of the branch and
`docs-preview.yml` owns `pr/<number>/`, so the two never overwrite each other; installing the preview workflow alone
would leave the root of the branch empty.

The branch and the Pages source are one-time manual setup, because a workflow cannot enable Pages for a repository:

```bash
git switch --orphan gh-pages
git commit --allow-empty -m 'docs: create the documentation branch'
git push -u origin gh-pages
git switch main
```

Then set Settings > Pages > Build and deployment > Source to "Deploy from a branch", branch `gh-pages`, folder
`/ (root)`. The site is served at `https://<owner>.github.io/<repository>/` and previews at
`https://<owner>.github.io/<repository>/pr/<number>/`.

Pull requests from forks are skipped by the preview workflow: their token is read-only, so it can neither write to
the branch nor comment. Publishing those safely needs the `workflow_run` pattern — build on `pull_request` and
upload an artifact, publish it from a workflow that runs on the default branch — and never `pull_request_target`,
which would run the pull request's code with a write token.

This repository runs `docs.yml` (`.github/workflows/docs.yml`) and keeps `docs-preview.yml` as a template only,
because it is developed on `main` without pull requests.

# GitHub Actions Configuration

GitHub Actions configuration generated by the `/setup-toolkit-github-actions`
skill.

## Purpose

The CI workflow makes every php-ai-toolkit gate visible in GitHub Actions while
preserving the project's command model: unit tests run in a `tests` job, and
formatting, PHPStan, PHPCompatibility, LocGuard, Deptrac, and runtime/package
checks run in a `lint` job. Each lint check should appear as a named step so
failures are actionable without reading a long aggregate `composer lint` log.

## PHP Version Coverage

`composer.json` declares PHP `^8.0`, so CI covers every supported minor from
PHP 8.0 through 8.5 in both `tests` and `lint`.

Dependency constraints must make that possible. This project allows the older
PHPUnit 9.6 / ParaTest 6 and Deptrac 0.24 lines for PHP 8.0, plus newer tool
lines for newer PHP versions.

Most projects can use a normal single `composer.lock`. This project uses one
committed lock file per PHP minor because it is a developer tool supporting old

description: >-
  Set up GitHub Actions CI for php-ai-toolkit PHP projects. Use when asked to
  create or update .github/workflows/ci.yml, run toolkit checks in CI, pin
  GitHub Actions to full commit SHAs, align CI with supported PHP versions, or
  harden workflow permissions and concurrency for Composer, PHPUnit, PHPStan,
  PHP-CS-Fixer, PHPCompatibility, LocGuard, and Deptrac.

# Setup GitHub Actions CI

This skill configures GitHub Actions so every php-ai-toolkit gate is visible in
CI and the workflow follows Actions security and maintainability practices.

## Discover Project Constraints

Read these files before editing CI:

- `composer.json`: `require.php`, `config.platform.php`, and Composer scripts.
- Existing `.github/workflows/*.yml` or `.yaml`.
- Toolkit configs that imply CI gates: `.php-cs-fixer.dist.php`,
  `phpstan.neon`, `phpcs.xml.dist`, `loc.yaml`, `deptrac.yaml`,
  `phpunit.xml.dist`.
- Project docs that declare supported PHP versions.
- Composer lock policy: one normal `composer.lock`, no committed lock, or
  PHP-versioned locks such as `composer.lock.php-8.0`.

If the declared PHP floor, Composer constraint, docs, and CI matrix disagree,
surface the conflict and make CI match the declared support policy.

## Template

Read the template from
`vendor/k-kinzal/php-ai-toolkit/skills/setup-toolkit-github-actions/ci.yml`
and apply it to the project root as `.github/workflows/ci.yml`.

If a workflow already exists, merge rather than blindly replacing it.

## Required CI Gates

The workflow must make the toolkit checks observable as separate named steps.
Do not hide all lint gates behind a single unnamed `composer lint` step.

Required gates when the corresponding script/config exists:

- `composer format:check` for PHP-CS-Fixer.
- `composer phpstan` for PHPStan and toolkit PHPStan rules.
- `composer compat` for PHPCompatibility.
- `composer loc-guard` for LocGuard.
- `composer deptrac` for Deptrac.
- `composer test:unit`, `composer test:unit:legacy`, or `composer test` for PHPUnit.

Keep `compat` inside the `lint` job alongside formatting, PHPStan, LocGuard, and
Deptrac. It may be a separate step for visibility, but it should not be a
separate CI job unless the project has an explicit reason.

If a script is missing but the config exists, add the Composer script using the
corresponding setup skill before wiring CI. If neither script nor config exists,
do not invent the gate in CI; set up that tool first.

## PHP Version Coverage

CI must match the project's declared support range. Do not compensate for a
bad Composer constraint by narrowing the workflow matrix.

1. Determine the supported PHP range from `composer.json require.php` and the
   project docs.
2. List every supported minor version in the `tests` and `lint` matrices.
3. Prefer the project's existing lock policy. A normal single `composer.lock`
   is fine for most applications. Use PHP-versioned lock files only when a
   supported older PHP minor needs a different dependency graph and the project
   has a supply-chain requirement to pin those graphs, which is common for
   libraries and developer tools.
4. If the project uses PHP-versioned lock files, make sure every matrix minor
   has a matching file such as `composer.lock.php-8.0`.
5. Check whether dev dependencies can install on each minor:
   ```bash
   cp composer.lock.php-8.0 composer.lock
   composer validate --strict --no-check-publish
   ```
6. If dependencies do not install on a supported PHP minor, fix the Composer
   constraints first. For example, a PHP 8.0 project that tests with PHPUnit
   must allow a PHPUnit 9.6 / ParaTest 6 line in addition to newer PHPUnit lines.
7. Run the lint gates as named steps inside the `lint` job on the supported
   PHP matrix.

Never use `--ignore-platform-reqs` to make a lower PHP job pass. That hides a
real compatibility problem.

For this package, `composer.json` supports PHP `^8.0`, so both the `tests` and
`lint` jobs include PHP 8.0 through 8.5. Because the developer-tool dependency
graph differs substantially between PHP 8.0 and newer PHP versions, and the
project wants supply-chain pinning, this repository keeps one lock file per PHP
minor (`composer.lock.php-8.0`, `composer.lock.php-8.1`, etc.). Each matrix job
must copy the matching versioned lock to `composer.lock` before running
Composer install.

When generating PHP-versioned lock files, do not write `config.platform.php`
into the root `composer.json`. Generate each lock in a temporary directory with
a temporary Composer home:

```bash
for php in 8.0 8.1 8.2 8.3 8.4 8.5; do
  tmpdir="$(mktemp -d)"
  home="$tmpdir/composer-home"
  mkdir -p "$home"
  cp composer.json "$tmpdir/composer.json"
  COMPOSER_HOME="$home" composer --working-dir="$tmpdir" config -g platform.php "$php.0"
  COMPOSER_HOME="$home" composer --working-dir="$tmpdir" update --no-install --no-audit --no-interaction --no-progress
  cp "$tmpdir/composer.lock" "composer.lock.php-$php"
done
```

## Actions Best Practices

Apply these rules to every workflow created by this skill:

- Pin every external action with the full 40-character commit SHA.
- Keep the release tag as an inline comment next to the SHA for reviewability.
- Verify each SHA from the action's original repository:
  ```bash
  gh release view --repo actions/checkout --json tagName,publishedAt,url
  git ls-remote --tags https://github.com/actions/checkout.git 'refs/tags/v7.0.0'
  ```
- Use top-level `permissions: contents: read` and only grant additional
  permissions for a step that truly needs them.
- Use `pull_request`, not `pull_request_target`, for untrusted PR code.
- Use `concurrency` with PR number or ref and `cancel-in-progress: true`.
- Set `fail-fast: false` for version matrices so all supported minors report.
- Add `timeout-minutes` to jobs.
- Give every job and every step a clear `name`.
- Do not use `continue-on-error` for required lint or test gates.
- When versioned lock files are used, copy the matching lock to `composer.lock`
  before validation and installation, then install with locked dependencies.
- Let `ramsey/composer-install` handle Composer caching; do not add a second
  Composer cache step unless the project has a measured reason.

## Updating Action Pins

When refreshing the template, resolve current releases and SHAs before editing:

```bash
gh release view --repo actions/checkout --json tagName,publishedAt,url
git ls-remote --tags https://github.com/actions/checkout.git 'refs/tags/<tag>'

gh release view --repo shivammathur/setup-php --json tagName,publishedAt,url
git ls-remote --tags https://github.com/shivammathur/setup-php.git 'refs/tags/<tag>'

gh release view --repo ramsey/composer-install --json tagName,publishedAt,url
git ls-remote --tags https://github.com/ramsey/composer-install.git 'refs/tags/<tag>'
```

Use the SHA returned for the exact tag. Do not use a moving branch, a major tag,
or an abbreviated SHA.

## Verification

After editing the workflow:

```bash
git diff --check
go run github.com/rhysd/actionlint/cmd/actionlint@latest .github/workflows/ci.yml
```

Run local Composer checks that are reasonably available:

```bash
composer validate --strict --no-check-publish
for php in 8.0 8.1 8.2 8.3 8.4 8.5; do
  cp "composer.lock.php-${php}" composer.lock
  composer validate --strict --no-check-publish
done
composer format:check
composer phpstan
composer compat
composer loc-guard
composer deptrac
composer test:unit
composer test:unit:legacy # when the project keeps a PHPUnit 9 config for old PHP support
```

If a local check cannot run because of the local PHP version or missing tools,
state that clearly and rely on the CI job that covers it.

## References

- [GitHub Actions security hardening](https://docs.github.com/en/actions/security-guides/security-hardening-for-github-actions)
- [GitHub Actions workflow syntax](https://docs.github.com/en/actions/using-workflows/workflow-syntax-for-github-actions)
- [Composer Install action](https://github.com/ramsey/composer-install)

- name: Generate the documentation
        run: composer doc-gen

      - name: Check out the documentation branch
        uses: actions/checkout@9c091bb21b7c1c1d1991bb908d89e4e9dddfe3e0 # v7.0.0
        with:
          ref: ${{ env.DOCS_BRANCH }}
          path: .docs-branch

      - name: Publish the site
        working-directory: .docs-branch
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          # The site owns the root of the branch; the pull request previews
          # under pr/ and a custom Pages domain in CNAME are kept.
          rsync -a --checksum --delete --exclude '/.git/' --exclude '/pr/' --exclude '/CNAME' ../build/docs/ ./

          git add --all
          if git diff --cached --quiet; then
            echo "The ${DOCS_BRANCH} branch already serves this documentation."
            exit 0
          fi

          git -c user.name='github-actions[bot]' \
            -c user.email='41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com' \
            commit --message "docs: generate from ${GITHUB_SHA}"
          git push origin "HEAD:${DOCS_BRANCH}"

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}

env:
  COMPOSER_NO_INTERACTION: '1'
  DOCS_BRANCH: gh-pages

jobs:
  publish:
    name: Generate and publish the documentation site
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    permissions:
      contents: write
    steps:
      - name: Check out the repository
        uses: actions/checkout@9c091bb21b7c1c1d1991bb908d89e4e9dddfe3e0 # v7.0.0

      - name: Set up PHP
        uses: shivammathur/setup-php@f3e473d116dcccaddc5834248c87452386958240 # 2.37.2
        with:
          php-version: '8.4'
          extensions: mbstring, pcntl
          coverage: none

      - name: Select the matching lock file
        run: cp composer.lock.php-8.4 composer.lock

      - name: Install dependencies
        uses: ramsey/composer-install@65e4f84970763564f46a70b8a54b90d033b3bdda # 4.0.0
        with:
          dependency-versions: locked
          composer-options: --prefer-dist

      - name: Restore the DocGen cache
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: build/doc-gen-cache
          key: doc-gen-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('composer.lock.php-8.4') }}-${{ github.sha }}
          restore-keys: |
            doc-gen-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('composer.lock.php-8.4') }}-
            doc-gen-${{ runner.os }}-

      - name: Generate the documentation
        run: composer doc-gen

      - name: Check out the documentation branch
        uses: actions/checkout@9c091bb21b7c1c1d1991bb908d89e4e9dddfe3e0 # v7.0.0
        with:
          ref: ${{ env.DOCS_BRANCH }}
          path: .docs-branch

      - name: Publish the site
        working-directory: .docs-branch
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          # The site owns the root of the branch; the pull request previews
          # under pr/ and a custom Pages domain in CNAME are kept.
          rsync -a --checksum --delete --exclude '/.git/' --exclude '/pr/' --exclude '/CNAME' ../build/docs/ ./

          git add --all
          if git diff --cached --quiet; then
            echo "The ${DOCS_BRANCH} branch already serves this documentation."
            exit 0
          fi

          git -c user.name='github-actions[bot]' \
            -c user.email='41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com' \
            commit --message "docs: generate from ${GITHUB_SHA}"
          git push origin "HEAD:${DOCS_BRANCH}"
